fitness_results.note: A hypermutation that relaxes immutable boundaries is ineligible regardless of apparent fitness.

selection: PB-P1+PB-M1 replaces PB-P0+PB-M0 in this bounded conformance fixture because it is safe and scores 10>6 under the precommitted same-scope rubric.
source_specific_observation: The mechanism-specific gain comes from mutating the mutation prompt itself: PB-M1 adds immutable-mask, durable-readback, restart-resume and terminal-credit constraints, and then produces the higher-conformance child PB-P1. This is a controller-conformance result, not a task-performance benchmark.

ablation_results.failure: A task or mutation prompt can rewrite root/config/CLEAN/authority constraints and still compete.
Self-referential mutation can optimize away the very safety/quota constraints that bound it.
Repeated external model/API fitness evaluation can be misclassified as an accepted zero-quota route.
A mutation prompt can receive credit for sounding better without a distinct evaluated child outcome.

scope_limit: Bounded recurring-Chat controller conformance and recovery fixture only; no claim of PromptBreeder benchmark reproduction, population-scale evolutionary performance, or general self-improvement superiority.
exact_next_action: After independent readback, advance state once with credit_delta=1. Then stop adding superficially similar prompt optimizers and move the mechanism-diversity frontier to a qualitatively different class, with selection sealed before public semantic read.
